text:
maya: Quick bakeoff update for ivy-30B kv-cache quant experiments. Ran FP16 baseline, INT8-kv, FP8-kv (kernel A), GPTQ-kv, AWQ-kv. Short summary:

maya: Memory: INT8-kv ~ -36% vs FP16, FP8-kv ~ -52%. Latency (median): FP16 12.4ms, INT8-kv 13.6ms (+1.2ms), FP8-kv 16.2ms (+3.8ms). P95 tail increases: INT8 +6ms, FP8 +18ms on long seq workloads (>4k).

maya: Quality (eval set of 10k prompts, mix of code+instr): RLHF-style passrate delta: INT8 -0.6% absolute, FP8 -1.9%, GPTQ -0.8%, AWQ -1.1%. Perplexity changes align with those numbers.

bench-bot: Automated run attached: config snippet:
```
model: ivy-30b
quant_modes: [fp16, int8-kv, fp8-kv, gptq-kv, awq-kv]
batch: 1
seq: [512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192]
warmup_requests: 200
measurements: 10
```

alex: Nice. Which hardware? and was multi-stream batching enabled?

maya: Tests on p4d (A100) and 3090-prototype nodes. No multi-stream batching for the baseline numbers — pure single-stream continuous batching disabled to isolate kv kernel cost.

liam: Any sign of GPU memory fragmentation or allocator churn with FP8-kv?

maya: Yeah — FP8-kv kernel A uses a temporary workspace per call; fragmentation shows up with seq>2048. Saw 5–8% extra reserved memory and occasional kernel enqueue stalls (logs included below).

sasha: Could this be mitigated by switching to our hybrid-kv layout (compact+prefetch)?

maya: We tried hybrid layout; it recovers ~60% of the FP8 tail penalty but adds ~0.4ms median. Good tradeoff for latency-sensitive tiers.

ops-bot: Flag created: #ops/kv-kernel-fp8-fallback. Assigned to @liam. Suggested immediate action: add a runtime flag `RESTRICT_FP8_KV_SEQ_MAX=2048` and a graceful fallback to INT8-kv when seq>limit.

alex: For rollout: do we enable on Dedicated only initially? Also need a canary with real traffic.

liam: Agree. Plan: ded-only for 2 weeks with 0.5% traffic canary then +5% increments.

maya: I'll upload full CSV with per-prompt diffs and the Eval run deck to the folder. TL;DR: INT8-kv looks like a safe default for most workloads; FP8-kv has better memory wins but needs kernel work / fallback for long-context.

maya: attaching top 10 failure examples where FP8 got answers garbled vs INT8 (small context hallucinations) — will add to regression suite.

sasha: Great. Thanks maya. :thumbsup:
